title: nirs4all Runtime RtRunRequest v1
$comment: LOCK-RT / RT-002 unified run-request envelope. The union of the run_via_dagml field set + the ExecutionDriverCapability execution_backend taxonomy + the net-new options.allow_fallback strict-mode flag. `execution_backend` (the environment) stays ORTHOGONAL to the ML `engine` (which rides in `options`). Net-new wrapper; pipeline_dsl is the existing pipeline_dsl compat contract.

pipeline_dsl.$comment: The pipeline DSL (the existing pipeline_dsl.schema.json compat contract). Carried opaque here so this envelope does not fork it.

dataset_ref.$comment: A dataset reference (path / config / id) the runtime resolves; shape is runtime-specific.

execution_backend.$comment: The execution ENVIRONMENT (ExecutionDriverCapability taxonomy), not the ML engine.
